claims.claim: Collecting money for charity on the street may require a street collection licence, depending on the local council.
claims.quote: If you want to collect money or sell items on the street for charity, you might need a street collection licence, depending on your local council.
claims.note: The page states this conditional licence requirement.

claims.claim: Selling items for charity on the street may require a street collection licence, depending on the local council.
claims.quote: If you want to collect money or sell items on the street for charity, you might need a street collection licence, depending on your local council.
claims.note: The page states this conditional licence requirement.

claims.claim: Collecting money for charity in other public places may require a street collection licence.
claims.quote: It’s not just ‘streets’ that are covered - you’ll need a licence if you collect money in public areas, eg a shop doorway or car park.
claims.note: The page extends the requirement to public areas.

claims.claim: Selling items for charity in other public places may require a street collection licence.
claims.quote: It’s not just ‘streets’ that are covered - you’ll need a licence if you collect money in public areas, eg a shop doorway or car park.
claims.note: The public area passage refers to collecting money but does not expressly extend the selling rule beyond streets.

claims.claim: Apply to the local council for a street collection licence.
claims.quote: How to apply Contact your local council to find out if you need a licence.
claims.note: The application section directs readers to their local council.

claims.claim: In Greater London outside the City of London, contact the Metropolitan Police for a licence.
claims.quote: In Greater London (except the City of London) you’ll need to contact the Metropolitan Police for a licence.
claims.note: The page gives this Greater London route.
